factor_specs.proxy: Unsupervised LSTM sequence-autoencoder reconstruction error (regime deviation from learned normal)
factor_specs.formula: LSTM seq-AE (enc LSTM 11->16, latent 8, dec LSTM->11), L=60 daily window of 11 market-priced features (KOSPI klog/kvol20/kcum20/kcum60 + VIX/Term_Spread/KRW/US10Y/US2Y/StL_FinStress/Chi_FinCond); anomaly = mean recon MSE; walk-forward expanding annual refit; NO label; IS-threshold tau = quantile(train recon err, 1 - m4_fire_rate=0.126); fire(recon>tau)->exposure 0.70 else 1.00; overlay = ae_exposure x AR x R05 (AR,R05 held FIXED = detector isolation)
factor_specs.lag_rule: signal window ends strictly before holding-month start (last_feat_date < decision_date); walk-forward PIT training on windows ending before year boundary; standardization frozen on training window
factor_specs.economic_rationale: An autoencoder learns the distribution of NORMAL market dynamics; a crash produces high reconstruction error BECAUSE it is atypical, so it is flagged even though no crash appeared in training. This structurally avoids the OOD failure that killed WT-004's SUPERVISED transformer (which needed in-sample crash analogs and stayed fully invested into 2008/COVID). Result: the unsupervised detector fires on the OOD crashes M4 and the transformer both under-covered (2008 GFC 9/9 vs M4 6/9 vs transformer 0/9).
references: Malhotra et al 2016 LSTM-AD (LSTM encoder-decoder anomaly)

factor_specs.proxy: Unsupervised dense point-autoencoder co-movement anomaly (trailing 21d mean recon error)
factor_specs.formula: dense AE 11->8->4->8->11 on single-day standardized feature vector; anomaly = trailing-21d mean per-vector recon MSE; same walk-forward + tau-match as seq-AE
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Captures cross-feature CONFIGURATION anomaly (e.g. VIX-high + term-inverted + KRW-spike simultaneously atypical) independent of temporal path. Highest crisis-firing correlation of all detectors (0.148 vs M4 0.062) but does NOT beat M4 on book calmar (1.976 < 2.069) -> reported for completeness; not selected.
